turns.responseText:
IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — Scales in vitro microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs using well-stirred and parallel-tube models.

Input: Compound data CSV with 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs (columns: compound_id, CLint_uL_per_min_mg, molecular_weight)
Key steps:

PKNCA + well-stirred/parallel-tube scaling → predicted CLh (mL/min/kg) per compound
Hepatic extraction ratio (EH) calculation → classified as low / intermediate / high extraction


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh + EH per compound) + clearance_summary.json (model comparison, scaling factors, fu,p and Qh assumptions)

Decision gate: EH < 0.3 = low-extraction (sensitive to fu,p and fu,mic); EH > 0.7 = high-extraction (flow-limited — CLh ≈ Qh ~20 mL/min/kg in humans); compounds in the intermediate zone (0.3–0.7) warrant experimental fu,p confirmation before advancing to in vivo PK prediction.

turns.responseText:
IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — BCR-ABL1 TKI Panel — Scales measured microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance (CLh) and extraction ratio (EH) for 4 TKIs using the well-stirred liver model.

Input: 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs — Dasatinib (CLint=220, fu_p=0.04), Bosutinib (CLint=60, fu_p=0.03), Imatinib (CLint=25, fu_p=0.04), Nilotinib (CLint=12, fu_p=0.01); Qh=20.7 mL/min/kg, fu_mic=1.0
Key steps:

PKNCA well-stirred model → CLint_scaled (μL/min/mg) × microsomal protein scaling factor → CLint_in vivo (mL/min/kg) per compound
Well-stirred equation: CLh = (Qh × fu_p × CLint) / (Qh + fu_p × CLint) → predicted CLh + EH per compound


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh mL/min/kg + EH per compound, both models) + clearance_summary.json (Qh, fu_mic, fu_p assumptions, extraction class per TKI)

Decision gate: EH > 0.7 = high-extraction / flow-limited (CLh approaches Qh ~20.7 mL/min/kg — dose adjustments needed for hepatic impairment); EH < 0.3 = low-extraction / capacity-limited (CLh highly sensitive to fu_p — protein binding shifts will significantly alter in vivo exposure).

Key steps:

Fetch & validate PDB 1IEP → cleaned structure file ready for pocket detection
fpocket → per-pocket druggability scores, volumes, and physicochemical descriptors for all detected cavities
Rank & filter top 10 pockets by druggability score + volume → annotated pocket summary



Expected output: pocket_summary.csv (top 10 pockets ranked by druggability score & volume) + druggability_scores.json (raw fpocket descriptors per pocket) + ranked HTML report with 3D pocket visualizations
